We need to produce JSON with judgments array. For each candidate id, we need verdict: supported, contradicted, not_established. Supported if policy entails it (i.e., the statement is logically implied by policy). Contradicted if policy conflicts with an explicit rule (i.e., the statement directly contradicts a rule in policy). Not_established if neither is established (i.e., not implied nor contradicted). Do not treat unstated implementation choice as supported. So we must carefully examine each candidate.

We have policy statements R01 through R12. Let's list them clearly:

R01: A new supplier must complete identity verification before its first purchase order.
R02: The Compliance officer performs identity verification; the buyer does not perform it.
R03: For a low-risk supplier, Compliance may request a site visit but is not obliged to request one.
R04: A high-risk supplier must undergo an enhanced review.
R05: A renewal for an existing supplier with no changed identity data is exempt from repeating identity verification.
R06: The renewal exemption does not apply when the supplier changes its legal name.
R07: A buyer must not activate a supplier flagged as blocked.
R08: A risk score of 70 or more is classified as high risk.
R09: Risk scores below 70 are classified as low risk.
R10: Approval expires 365 calendar days after its approval date.
R11: Changing a supplier bank account requires a new independent bank-account check before the next payment.
R12: Two supplier records may share a contact email address; the email address is not unique.

We need to evaluate each candidate statement.

We need to consider entailment: does the policy entail the candidate? For example, candidate P004: "Identity verification must precede the first order with a new supplier." This matches R01 exactly. So supported.

Candidate P001: "Email addresses must belong to a company-owned domain." Policy does not mention email domain requirement. Not in policy. Not contradicted. So not_established.

Candidate P002: "A changed bank account must be checked independently before the next payment." R11 says: Changing a supplier bank account requires a new independent bank-account check before the next payment. That matches. So supported.

Candidate P003: "Enhanced review is optional for high-risk suppliers." R04 says: A high-risk supplier must undergo an enhanced review. That means it's mandatory, not optional. So P003 contradicts R04. So contradicted.

Candidate P005: "The buyer performs identity verification." R02 says: The Compliance officer performs identity verification; the buyer does not perform it. So P005 contradicts R02. Contradicted.

Candidate P006: "A buyer may activate a blocked supplier." R07 says: A buyer must not activate a supplier flagged as blocked. So P006 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P007: "Blocked supplier records are deleted automatically after one year." No rule about deletion. Not contradicted. Not supported. So not_established.

Candidate P008: "A changed legal name prevents use of the renewal exemption." R06: The renewal exemption does not apply when the supplier changes its legal name. That means if legal name changes, exemption does NOT apply. So a changed legal name prevents use of the renewal exemption. That matches. So supported.

Candidate P009: "A high-risk enhanced review must include a credit score above 700." No rule about credit score requirement. Not contradicted. Not supported. So not_established.

Candidate P010: "Site visits are optional for low-risk suppliers." R03: For a low-risk supplier, Compliance may request a site visit but is not obliged to request one. That says site visits are optional (may request but not obliged). So supported.

Candidate P011: "A score equal to 70 is high risk." R08: A risk score of 70 or more is classified as high risk. So yes, score equal to 70 is high risk. Supported.

Candidate P012: "A trading-name change requires a EUR 100 processing fee." No mention. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P013: "The independent check must be performed by the bank using video identification." No rule about method. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P014: "Different supplier records can share the same contact email." R12: Two supplier records may share a contact email address; the email address is not unique. This says they can share, i.e., different records can share same email. So supported.

Candidate P015: "A site visit is mandatory for every low-risk supplier." R03 says site visit is optional (may request but not obliged). So mandatory contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P016: "A changed bank account can be used for the next payment without a new check." R11 says changing bank account requires a new independent check before next payment. So P016 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P017: "Unchanged identity data exempts an existing supplier renewal from repeat verification." R05: A renewal for an existing supplier with no changed identity data is exempt from repeating identity verification. That matches. Supported.

Candidate P018: "A risk score of 69 is low risk." R09: Risk scores below 70 are classified as low risk. 69 < 70, so low risk. Supported.

Candidate P019: "A renewal after a legal-name change is exempt from identity verification." R06 says renewal exemption does not apply when supplier changes legal name. So renewal after legal name change is NOT exempt. So P019 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P020: "Unchanged identity data must be certified by an external notary." No rule about notary. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P021: "Enhanced review is required for high-risk suppliers." R04: A high-risk supplier must undergo an enhanced review. So supported.

Candidate P022: "A risk score of 69 is high risk." R08: >=70 high risk. 69 is not high risk. R09: below 70 low risk. So P022 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P023: "Every supplier contact email is unique." R12 says email not unique; may share. So P023 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P024: "Blocked suppliers cannot be activated by a buyer." R07: buyer must not activate a blocked supplier. So supported.

Candidate P025: "An expiry reminder must be sent by SMS seven days in advance." No rule. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P026: "A Compliance officer must hold a specific professional certificate." No rule. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P027: "Identity verification must use a passport rather than another identity document." No rule. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P028: "Every renewal with unchanged identity data requires repeat identity verification." R05 says renewal with no changed identity data is exempt from repeating identity verification. So P028 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P029: "Identity verification belongs to the Compliance officer." R02 says the Compliance officer performs identity verification; the buyer does not. So identity verification belongs to compliance officer. That matches. Supported.

Candidate P030: "Supplier approval expires after 30 calendar days from approval." R10 says expires after 365 days. So P030 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P031: "The scoring formula assigns a 40 percent weight to country risk." No rule. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P032: "Supplier approval expires after 365 calendar days from approval." R10 says exactly that. Supported.

Candidate P033: "A new supplier may receive its first order before identity verification." R01 says must complete identity verification before first purchase order. So P033 contradicts. Contradicted.

Candidate P034: "Risk scores are rounded to the nearest ten before classification." No rule. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P035: "Low-risk supplier site visits are conducted every six months." R03 says optional; no schedule. Not contradicted. Not supported. Not_established.

Candidate P036: "A score equal to 70 is low risk." R08 says >=70 high risk. So contradicts. Contradicted.
